snippet.title: PigPonyPocalypse – Release Trailer | Hardcore Boss Rush | Out Oct 13 on Steam
snippet.description:
Four bosses. No filler. Every death is on you.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4385110/PigPonyPocalypse/

PigPonyPocalypse is a hardcore boss rush coming to Steam on October 13, 2026 (Windows & macOS). Learn the patterns, die, try again. On True Challenge every boss gets new phases and mechanics, and your best DPS goes to a global leaderboard.

• 4 bosses, 2 difficulties
• 9 talents, global DPS leaderboards for every boss
• A tank who dreams of getting punched in the face and a healer who refuses to heal him
• Original metal soundtrack
• English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский

Website: https://pigponypocalypse.com
Press kit: https://pigponypocalypse.com/presskit/
Discord: https://discord.gg/fwwNwaWAKT

#PigPonyPocalypse #BossRush #IndieGame
